verse.verse_1: Have you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) not seen how your Lord dealt with the Owners of the Elephant? [The elephant army which came from Yemen under the command of Abrahah Al-Ashram intending to destroy the Ka'bah at Makkah].
verse.verse_2: Did He not make their plot go astray?
verse.verse_3: And sent against them birds, in flocks,
verse.verse_4: Striking them with stones of Sijjil.
verse.verse_5: And made them like an empty field of stalks (of which the corn has been eaten up by cattle).
